adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts, evt.destinationCalendar is initialized to `[eventType.destinationCalendar]`, or `[organizerUser.destinationCalendar]`, or `null` (not `[]`) when neither exists. Later, for COLLECTIVE team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`, which will no-op when evt.destinationCalendar is `null`. That means in the scenario where only team members (users.slice(1)) have destination calendars (collected into `teamDestinationCalendars`), those calendars are silently not added to `evt.destinationCalendar` and thus excluded from downstream calendar event creation.
